title: 尖刺要塞·第一人称3D
lua:
-- spiked keep : first person raycaster dungeon
state="title"
tick=0
mt={
"############",
"#....##....#",
"#....##....#",
"#..........#",
"#....D#....#",
"###.#..#.###",
"###.#..#.###",
"#....##....#",
"#..........#",
"#....##....#",
"#....##....#",
"############"
}
m={}
zb={}
objs={{},{},{}}
p={x=2.5,y=2.5,a=0}
kx=9.5
ky=9.5
gx=6.5
gy=6.5
has_key=false
hx=4.5
hy=3.5
wx={4.5,8.5,8.5,3.5,3.5}
wy={3.5,3.5,8.5,8.5,3.5}
wi=2
msg=""
msg_t=0
warn_cd=0
danger=false

function tileat(cx,cy)
 if cx<0 or cy<0 or cx>11 or cy>11 then return 1 end
 return m[cy*12+cx]
end
function solid(cx,cy)
 if cx<0 or cy<0 or cx>11 or cy>11 then return true end
 return m[cy*12+cx]!=0
end
function block(x,y)
 local r=0.24
 return solid(flr(x-r),flr(y-r)) or solid(flr(x+r),flr(y-r)) or solid(flr(x-r),flr(y+r)) or solid(flr(x+r),flr(y+r))
end
function dist(ax,ay,bx,by)
 local dx=ax-bx
 local dy=ay-by
 return sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
end
function face(thedist)
 return tileat(flr(p.x+cos(p.a)*thedist),flr(p.y+sin(p.a)*thedist))
end
function cprint(s,y,c)
 print(s,64-#s*2,y,c)
end

function reset()
 m={}
 for r=0,11 do
  local row=mt[r+1]
  for c=0,11 do
   local ch=sub(row,c+1,c+1)
   local t=0
   if ch=="#" then t=1 elseif ch=="D" then t=2 end
   m[r*12+c]=t
  end
 end
 for i=0,31 do zb[i]=99 end
 p={x=2.5,y=2.5,a=0}
 has_key=false
 hx=4.5
 hy=3.5
 wi=2
 msg="find the key" msg_t=150
 warn_cd=0
 danger=false
 tick=0
end

function _init()
 reset()
 music(6,200,3)
end

function _update()
 tick+=1
 if state=="title" then
  if btnp(4) then
   reset()
   state="play"
   sfx(-1,3)
   music(0,200,7)
  end
 elseif state=="play" then
  update_play()
 else
  if btnp(4) then
   reset()
   state="play"
   sfx(-1,3)
   music(0,200,7)
  end
  if btnp(5) then
   state="title"
   music(-1,200)
   music(6,200,3)
  end
 end
end

function update_play()
 if btn(0) then p.a-=0.028 end
 if btn(1) then p.a+=0.028 end
 local mv=0
 if btn(2) then mv=0.075 elseif btn(3) then mv=-0.058 end
 if mv!=0 then
  local dx=cos(p.a)*mv
  local dy=sin(p.a)*mv
  if not block(p.x+dx,p.y) then p.x+=dx end
  if not block(p.x,p.y+dy) then p.y+=dy end
 end
 local dd=dist(hx,hy,wx[wi],wy[wi])
 if dd<=0.047 then
  hx=wx[wi]
  hy=wy[wi]
  wi+=1
  if wi>5 then wi=1 end
 else
  hx+=(wx[wi]-hx)/dd*0.047
  hy+=(wy[wi]-hy)/dd*0.047
 end
 local gd=dist(p.x,p.y,hx,hy)
 danger=gd<2.2
 if warn_cd>0 then warn_cd-=1 end
 if danger and warn_cd<=0 then
  sfx(18,3)
  warn_cd=50
 end
 if gd<0.55 then
  state="dead"
  msg=""
  music(-1,200)
  sfx(4,3)
  return
 end
 if dist(p.x,p.y,gx,gy)<0.7 then
  state="win"
  msg=""
  music(-1,200)
  sfx(3,3)
  return
 end
 if msg_t>0 then msg_t-=1 end
 if btnp(4) then act() end
end

function act()
 if not has_key and dist(p.x,p.y,kx,ky)<0.85 then
  has_key=true
  sfx(0,3)
  msg="key taken"
  msg_t=120
  return
 end
 local t1=face(0.6)
 local t2=face(1.1)
 if t1==2 or t2==2 then
  if has_key then
   if t1==2 then m[flr(p.y+sin(p.a)*0.6)*12+flr(p.x+cos(p.a)*0.6)]=0 end
   if t2==2 then m[flr(p.y+sin(p.a)*1.1)*12+flr(p.x+cos(p.a)*1.1)]=0 end
   sfx(17,3)
   msg="gate open"
   msg_t=150
  else
   sfx(16,3)
   msg="locked - need key"
   msg_t=120
  end
  return
 end
 if has_key then
  msg="no gate here"
 else
  msg="need the key"
 end
 msg_t=50
end

function _draw()
 if state=="title" then
  draw_title()
  return
 end
 draw_world()
 if danger and state=="play" and tick%16<8 then rect(0,0,127,127,8) end
 draw_hud()
 draw_mini()
 if state=="dead" then draw_end(false) end
 if state=="win" then draw_end(true) end
end

function draw_world()
 rectfill(0,0,127,127,5)
 rectfill(0,0,127,63,0)
 local ca=cos(p.a)
 local sa=sin(p.a)
 local plx=-sa*0.66
 local ply=ca*0.66
 for c=0,31 do
  local cam=(c+0.5)/16-1
  local rx=ca+plx*cam
  local ry=sa+ply*cam
  local mapx=flr(p.x)
  local mapy=flr(p.y)
  local ddx=999
  local ddy=999
  if abs(rx)>0.0001 then ddx=abs(1/rx) end
  if abs(ry)>0.0001 then ddy=abs(1/ry) end
  local stx=1
  local sty=1
  local sx=0
  local sy=0
  if rx<0 then
   stx=-1
   sx=(p.x-mapx)*ddx
  else
   sx=(mapx+1-p.x)*ddx
  end
  if ry<0 then
   sty=-1
   sy=(p.y-mapy)*ddy
  else
   sy=(mapy+1-p.y)*ddy
  end
  local side=0
  local tile=0
  local steps=0
  while tile==0 and steps<26 do
   if sx<sy then
    sx+=ddx
    mapx+=stx
    side=0
   else
    sy+=ddy
    mapy+=sty
    side=1
   end
   tile=tileat(mapx,mapy)
   steps+=1
  end
  local perp=99
  if side==0 then perp=sx-ddx else perp=sy-ddy end
  if perp<0.06 then perp=0.06 end
  local h=128/perp
  local y0=64-h/2
  local y1=64+h/2
  local col=1
  if tile==2 then
   if c%2==0 then col=8 else col=9 end
  elseif side==0 then
   col=13
  end
  rectfill(c*4,max(0,y0),c*4+3,min(127,y1),col)
  zb[c]=perp
 end
 local n=1
 objs[n].x=kx objs[n].y=ky objs[n].z=0.42 objs[n].h=0.5 objs[n].s=32 objs[n].w=0.62 objs[n].vis=not has_key
 n=2
 objs[n].x=gx objs[n].y=gy objs[n].z=0.55 objs[n].h=1.05 objs[n].s=34 objs[n].w=0.9 objs[n].vis=true
 n=3
 objs[n].x=hx objs[n].y=hy objs[n].z=0.5 objs[n].h=0.92 objs[n].s=33 objs[n].w=0.95 objs[n].vis=true
 for i=1,3 do
  objs[i].tz=ca*(objs[i].x-p.x)+sa*(objs[i].y-p.y)
 end
 for i=1,3 do
  for j=i+1,3 do
   if objs[j].tz>objs[i].tz then
    local tmp=objs[i]
    objs[i]=objs[j]
    objs[j]=tmp
   end
  end
 end
 for i=1,3 do
  if objs[i].vis then draw_obj(objs[i],ca,sa) end
 end
end

function draw_obj(o,ca,sa)
 local dx=o.x-p.x
 local dy=o.y-p.y
 local tz=ca*dx+sa*dy
 if tz<0.32 then return end
 local tx=(ca*dy-sa*dx)/0.66
 local cx=16*(1+tx/tz)
 local hw=8*o.w/(0.66*tz)
 local c0=max(0,flr(cx-hw))
 local c1=min(31,flr(cx+hw))
 if c1<c0 then return end
 local dh=o.h*128/tz
 local top=64+(0.5-o.z)*128/tz-dh/2
 local sox=(o.s%16)*8
 local soy=flr(o.s/16)*8
 local span=c1-c0+1
 for c=c0,c1 do
  if tz<zb[c] then
   local sx=flr(8*(c-c0+0.5)/span)
   if sx>7 then sx=7 end
   sspr(sox+sx,soy,1,8,c*4,top,4,dh)
  end
 end
end

function draw_hud()
 if has_key then
  print("gate: green",2,3,10)
  spr(32,2,11)
  print("key",12,13,10)
 else
  print("find the key",2,3,7)
  print("key: none",2,11,6)
 end
 local hint="look for the key"
 local t1=face(0.6)
 local t2=face(1.1)
 if t1==2 or t2==2 then
  if has_key then hint="o: open the gate" else hint="locked - need key" end
 elseif not has_key and dist(p.x,p.y,kx,ky)<2.1 then
  hint="o: take the key"
 elseif has_key then
  hint="find the green gate"
 end
 if msg_t>0 then
  cprint(msg,108,7)
 elseif danger then
  cprint("spikes near",108,8)
 end
 cprint(hint,118,6)
end

function draw_mini()
 local mx=100
 local my=4
 rectfill(mx-1,my-1,mx+24,my+24,0)
 for cy=0,11 do
  for cx=0,11 do
   local t=m[cy*12+cx]
   if t!=0 then
    local col=13
    if t==2 then col=9 end
    rectfill(mx+cx*2,my+cy*2,mx+cx*2+1,my+cy*2+1,col)
   end
  end
 end
 if not has_key then
  rectfill(mx+flr(kx)*2,my+flr(ky)*2,mx+flr(kx)*2+1,my+flr(ky)*2+1,10)
 end
 rectfill(mx+flr(gx)*2,my+flr(gy)*2,mx+flr(gx)*2+1,my+flr(gy)*2+1,11)
 rectfill(mx+flr(hx)*2,my+flr(hy)*2,mx+flr(hx)*2+1,my+flr(hy)*2+1,8)
 rectfill(mx+flr(p.x)*2,my+flr(p.y)*2,mx+flr(p.x)*2+1,my+flr(p.y)*2+1,7)
 local ax=mx+(p.x+cos(p.a)*0.7)*2
 local ay=my+(p.y+sin(p.a)*0.7)*2
 if ax>mx and ax<mx+24 and ay>my and ay<my+24 then pset(ax,ay,6) end
end

function draw_title()
 rectfill(0,0,127,127,0)
 cprint("spiked keep",14,10)
 spr(33,34,26)
 spr(32,52,26)
 spr(34,70,26)
 cprint("first person dungeon",44,6)
 cprint("arrows: turn and walk",54,7)
 cprint("o: interact",64,7)
 cprint("find the key, open the gate",76,11)
 cprint("one touch is fatal",88,8)
 if tick%32<16 then
  cprint("o: start",106,10)
 else
  cprint("o: start",106,7)
 end
end

function draw_end(won)
 rectfill(0,42,127,86,0)
 if won then
  rectfill(0,42,127,43,11)
  cprint("you escaped",50,11)
  cprint("spikes and all",60,7)
 else
  rectfill(0,42,127,43,8)
  cprint("you died",50,8)
  cprint("the spikes got you",60,7)
 end
 cprint("o: play again",72,10)
 cprint("x: title",82,6)
end

design.core_action: 第一人称2.5D射线视角：左右方向键转身，上/下键前进后退，O 键交互（靠近钥匙拾取、面朝闸门开锁）。
design.goal: 在封闭的12×12地牢内找到钥匙，打开中央铁闸，走进壁龛里的绿色传送门即逃出。
design.risk: 尖刺守卫沿四角环路持续巡逻，接触（<0.55格）即死亡；失败后按 O 整轮从起点重开，钥匙、闸门、守卫全部复位。
design.controls: 方向键：左/右转向、上/下前进后退；O：拾取钥匙、开闸门、失败/胜利后重开；结束画面 X 返回标题；标题画面 O 开始。
design.scenes: title（提示+开始）/ play（射线世界+HUD+小地图）/ dead（O重开、X标题）/ win（同上），同一张手工地图、封闭外墙。
design.audiovisual: 标题播 pattern6 gentle loop，游玩播 pattern0 Kajam 迷宫主题（声道0-2，声道3留交互音效）；SFX 0 拾取、16 上锁、17 开闸、18 尖刺预警（带冷却）、4 死亡、3 逃脱；HUD显示目标、钥匙状态、上下文提示与小地图（墙/闸门/钥匙/传送门/玩家/守卫）。
preserve: 12×12手工地图与封闭外墙、单格宽通路
钥匙在中央铁闸未开启前可达，传送门只能经闸门进入
物品用逐列深度测试遮挡，不会画在墙后
O 交互、X 返回标题的按键分工
内置SFX 0..15与 pattern 0/6 未改动，自定义只用 16..18 与精灵 32..34
unresolved: 守卫巡逻速度0.047格/帧与0.55格致死距离的实际手感需要试玩确认
转身速度0.028圈/帧是否需要再调，待试玩
